narratives.Overview:
## Summary

AppSec scan on **`c3b76af8`** (post-**#3545**) found two **HIGH** UAT Shell classification residuals and one **MEDIUM** incomplete mint-path fix.

Under active UAT, further write-capable binaries still classify empty / unclassifiable and **allow** write-shaped Shell. That path can plant a forged `.deft/authz` grant or a regular-file `.deft-directive-disable` kill-switch. Separately, residual Shell writers can still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied, so the #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 mint gate is incomplete.

These residuals use dest forms that **#3545's harvest does not cover** (`inkscape --export-filename`; `babel --out-file`; `lessc` / `sass` / `dart-sass`; `ar rcs`; `emacs --batch`; `ps2pdf` / `pdftotext` / `pdfunite`; `ebook-convert`; `abiword --to=`; `makeself`; `flatpak-builder --repo=`; `appimagetool`; `restic backup -r`; `borg create`; `duplicity file://`).

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `c3b76af8`
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT** with PreToolUse Shell hooks

**Already denied after #3545 (do not re-report):** `rubyN` / `jruby` / `pypy`, Perl `write_file` / `spew` / `open F,">"`, `make DESTDIR=`, `dpkg -x`, `fromdos` / `todos`, `emacsclient` / `pico`, `pdftk` / `gs`, `npx degit`, `composer`, `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `sg_dd`, `darcs --repodir=`, `cp`, `python3`. Contrast: those peers remain settings-denied. `emacs --batch` is a different dest form from `emacsclient`. `ps2pdf` / `pdftotext` / `pdfunite` are a different harvest from `pdftk` / `gs`.

**Siblings, not duplicates:** open **#3593** tracks a *different* post-#3545 harvest (`raku` / `graalpy` / `crystal` / ...) plus MCP write / `CallMcpTool` routing and a migrate agents-header symlink sink. Open **#3626** tracks `ffmpeg` / `sox` / Lisp / build dest writers. Open **#3728** tracks `erl` / `sage` / CAS / `tcpdump` / `screen` / `joe` / `guestfish` / `adb` / `dmd` / `vbc`. Open **#3764** tracks `qjs` / `ipython` / `csi` / `chrome` / `lame` / `webpack` / ... plus the CHANGELOG leaf-symlink sink. Do **not** close this as a duplicate of those, and do **not** reopen #3545.

---

## Findings

### 1. HIGH — UAT residual after #3545: inkscape / babel / sass / ar / emacs --batch / pdf / makeself / restic / borg / ... still plant `.deft/authz` grants

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT with PreToolUse Shell hooks |
| **Input** | Residual writers whose dest is **not** covered by the #3545 harvest: `inkscape --export-filename`; `babel --out-file`; `lessc` / `sass` / `dart-sass`; `ar rcs`; `emacs --batch`; `ps2pdf` / `pdftotext` / `pdfunite`; `ebook-convert`; `abiword --to=`; `makeself`; `flatpak-builder --repo=`; `appimagetool`; `restic backup -r`; `borg create`; `duplicity file://` when dest mentions `.deft/authz` |
| **Path** | Residual bins classify `[]` → `shell-op-unclassifiable` **allow** → forged operator-cli grant JSON → empty `activeGrantIds` activates human-origin grants → Write / push / PR / merge unlock. Contrast: `cp` / `python3` targeting the same dest **deny** / `authz-grant-missing`. |
| **Impact** | Complete residual bypass of Wave 1 UAT human-approval after #3545 |
| **Fix** | Classify these dest writers when the path mentions `.deft/authz`. Under UAT, **fail-closed** on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell. Do **not** stop at named-peer allowlists. `cp` / `python3` already deny. |

### 2. HIGH — UAT residual after #3545: same writer class still plants `.deft-directive-disable`

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual class targeting `.deft-directive-disable` as a regular file |
| **Path** | classify `[]` → Shell **allow** → plant kill-switch → subsequent tools `allow` / `directive-disabled` (`detectDeftDirectiveDisable.active`, #3039) |
| **Impact** | Immediate complete Directive gate bypass for the rest of the session |
| **Fix** | Same classify extensions for kill-switch basenames (`.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive`). Mirror the authz fail-closed posture from finding (1). |

### 3. MEDIUM — Incomplete #3545: residual Shell writers still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual dest writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/<plan-id>.json` after Write is denied for the same path (Write denied; residual writers above still allow; contrast `cp` denied) |
| **Path** | Write denies the mint artifact; residual Shell classify misses the dest form → **allow** → forged provenance approval without `#3110` human-presence mint |
| **Impact** | Bypasses #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 mint gate via Write / Shell asymmetry |
| **Fix** | Extend approved-scope Shell classify to the same residual dest writers as findings (1) and (2). |

## Acceptance criteria

**HIGH — UAT Shell residuals (must land together)**

- [ ] Under active UAT, listed residual binaries that write into `.deft/authz/**` classify as **settings deny** (not unclassifiable allow)
- [ ] Same bins targeting `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as **settings deny**
- [ ] Dest parsing covers `inkscape --export-filename`, `babel --out-file`, `lessc` / `sass` / `dart-sass`, `ar rcs`, `emacs --batch`, `ps2pdf` / `pdftotext` / `pdfunite`, `ebook-convert`, `abiword --to=`, `makeself`, `flatpak-builder --repo=`, `appimagetool`, `restic backup -r`, `borg create`, `duplicity file://` when dest is protected
- [ ] Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable **write-shaped** Shell under UAT (not silent allow). Do not stop at named-peer allowlists.
- [ ] Regression tests cover residual bins vs already-denied peers (`python3` / `cp`)
- [ ] No false deny of ordinary non-authz / non-kill-switch dests (e.g. `/tmp`) outside UAT write paths

**MEDIUM — approved-scope mint symmetry**

- [ ] Under active UAT, residual Shell writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/**` classify as **settings deny**, matching Write
- [ ] Forged Shell mint cannot satisfy provenance approval without the shared #3110 human-presence mint

- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` security note (brief; no exploit cookbook)

```quarantined
## 1. Body named-bin settings harvest cannot bind — `blocks-the-design`

Evidence. At `e48db87`, dest-last / dest-flag-in-set / last-dest-bin / quoted-eval forms of the listed writers emit `["unknown"]`, not `[]`:

- `inkscape in.svg --export-filename DEST` (space dest, including a following `--export-type=png`)

- `restic backup -r DEST /src`; `restic restore --target DEST SNAPSHOT`

- `borg create DEST` dest-last fixture

Controls match the scan table: `cp` / `python3` → `["settings"]`; `/tmp` dests, `cat .deft/authz/...`, `git status` → `[]`.

`unknown` under active UAT is grant-immune deny (`evaluate.ts` `op === "unknown"` → `authz-uat-deny`). Empty ops skip authz (`dispatcher.ts` `ops.length === 0` → `null` → later `shell-op-unclassifiable` allow). Dest-visible empty-ops (#4199 / #4188 / PR #4492) deliberately emit `unknown`, not grantable `settings`.

Failure mode. Binding this body as the next-build contract would (a) re-harvest named bins the #3953 set-level already dominated into corpus (comment 5496112923), (b) recode already-closed dest-of-write as `settings`, so a settings-class grant could plant `.deft/authz` / kill-switch / `.deft/approved-scope` that dest-visible `unknown` currently refuses, and (c) miss the leftover unique dest-grammars that still fail open.

Disposition. Do not bind the body AC. Successor lean recuts next-build off this body. Named bins stay corpus.
```

```quarantined
## 2. Leftover unique dest-grammars still classify empty — `sharpens-framing`

Evidence. Same probe, protected dests still `[]`:

- `inkscape --export-filename=DEST` (attached; dest is not a positional)
- `ar rcs DEST foo.o` / `llvm-ar rcs DEST foo.o` (archive dest is the first operand, not last)
- `flatpak-builder --repo=DEST builddir manifest` and `--repo DEST …` (`--repo` is not in EMPTY_OPS_DEST_FLAGS)
- `borg create DEST::archive /tmp/src`; `borg create --repo DEST archive /src`
- `restic backup --repo DEST /src` / `--repository` / `--repo=` (`-r` is closed; `--repo` is not)
- `abiword --to=DEST in.doc`; `abiword --to=pdf --to-name=DEST in.doc`
- `emacs --batch --eval (write-file (concat ".deft" "/authz/…"))` (no quoted dest literal)

Adjacent existing producers disagree on class: `flatpak-builder --repodir=DEST` / `--repo-dir=DEST` → `["settings"]` (GENERIC_PROTECTED_EXTRA_DEST_FLAGS); dest-visible dest-flags → `["unknown"]`; unique `--repo=` → `[]`.

Failure mode. PreToolUse Shell with those dest-grammars still takes the empty-ops path: `classifyHookAuthzOps` empty → `authzForMutation` returns null → `shell-op-unclassifiable` allow. Under active UAT that plants a forged `.deft/authz` grant, a regular-file kill-switch, or a forged `.deft/approved-scope` mint. Shared `.deft/authz` / kill-switch / approved-scope is cohort state: one worker's unclassifiable Shell write is every sibling's authority. Untrusted shell input is the classify token walk; PreToolUse identity is `classifyHookAuthzOps` / `SHELL_TOOL_NAMES`. Closing leftover unique as `settings` (the `--repodir` path) would make the plant grantable. Closing it as dest-visible `unknown` keeps grant-immunity.

Disposition. Recut leftover uniqueness onto the existing dest-visible empty-ops producers (`EMPTY_OPS_DEST_FLAGS` for `--export-filename` / `--repo` / `--to-name`; dest-not-last first-operand dest for `ar rcs` / `borg create REPO::`), emitting `unknown`, not a named-bin add to `UAT_RESIDUAL_DEST_WRITE_BINS_3545` and not GENERIC `settings`.

Road-not-taken. Named-bin membership would catch dest-not-last for those argv0s without listing each flag spelling. Steelman: `restic --repo` vs `-r` is exactly that miss, and first-operand `ar rcs ARCHIVE objs` is not a dest-flag. Flip if a dest-flag add false-denies a proven non-dest (`cargo --target` is the recorded skip). Counter: `EMPTY_OPS_LAST_DEST_BINS` already covers dest-not-last as `unknown` (`makeself`); putting `ar`/`borg` there would also treat a protected archive *member* as dest. First-operand dest-grammar is the tighter existing-shaped extension. `git` is already a non-writer first bin, so `--repo` on dest-flag empty-ops does not harvest `git --repo`.
```
